text:
Tara Lim: Quick sync 5 managers: timeline reminder + a couple process updates. Handbacks + manager forms due Fri 11:59pm PST. If you need an accommodation (parental leave, medical, travel), reply here or DM people-ops and well flag an exception.

Noah Brooks: Do we still have the two-step handback (manager then skip-level) or did that change?

Tara Lim: Two-step remains for ICs being considered for promotion: manager handback then skip-level review. For regular handbacks only manager is needed.

Jin Park: For new hires (<90 days), should I mark goals as prorated in the form or leave core goals blank?

Tara Lim: Prorate where meaningful. If not applicable, put N/A and add 1-line rationale in the notes. That helps calibration.

Oliver Grant: We have three managers in my org traveling next week. Is proxy via the form enough or do you need an email?

Tara Lim: Form proxy is sufficient if you fill `proxy_reviewer` and they accept. If proxy unresponsive, email people-ops@redwood.com and well assign a temp reviewer.

people-ops-bot: Heads-up: 36 hours left to submit manager reviews for 9 items in Tara's queue. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

Noah Brooks: Calibration size question 5 we've historically had 12-15 per block and it drags. Can we cap at 8-10 and request extra blocks?

Tara Lim: Yes cap at ~8 for live discussion. If you have more, split into multiple files and label them Group A / Group B in the calibration template. Well schedule additional blocks.

Jin Park: CSV bulk upload fields? I saw multiple versions. Which header is canonical?

Tara Lim: Canonical CSV header: `email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot`. Please use ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD`. Example: 
```
email,manager,handback_date,proxy_reviewer,notes,preferred_slot
jin@redwood.com,jin.manager@redwood.com,2025-06-18,oliver@redwood.com,"prefers pm",PM
```

Oliver Grant: If a manager wants a private calibration discussion (sensitive promotion cases), how do we flag that?

Tara Lim: In the template include `confidential: yes` and a 1-line reason. People-ops will create a redacted packet and schedule a private block with HR present.

Noah Brooks: One more 5 can managers request an AM vs PM slot?

Tara Lim: Add `preferred_slot` in the CSV or template (AM/PM). Well try to honor preferences but cant guarantee.

people-ops-bot: Note: Upload endpoint accepts max file size 8MB. If you hit limits, email people-ops with CSV snippets. :mailbox_with_mail:

Tara Lim: Thanks team 5 well post the provisional calibration calendar by EOD Wed. If anyone needs a same-day exception due to travel, flag it before Thu noon.

Oliver Grant: Uploading CSV now. Thanks!

Jin Park: Will send prorated goal guidance to my managers and paste the snippet here for visibility.

Tara Lim: Perfect 5 thanks. Ping me for urgent edge cases.
